description: This file defines an interface for token-based authorization strategies in the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies a method for adding authorization tokens to HTTP requests.

classes.name: TokenAuthorization
classes.description: An interface that abstracts the addition of authorization tokens to HTTP requests using AWS signature protocols.

methods.name: authorizeRequest
methods.description: Adds an authorization token to the given HTTP request by modifying the request headers, returning the signed request.
